input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include authentication, protected, security. Core business data revolves around CerberusUser, CerberusUserFactory, DomainBase, ModelBase. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage authentication operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage protected operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with security functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
